answer.value: Avila Adobe is by far the most popular museum with an average of 24,062 visitors, significantly higher than the other three museums. America Tropical Interpretive Center ranks second with 7,107 average visitors, followed by Firehouse Museum at 6,473 and Chinese American Museum at 2,721. The data shows a clear hierarchy with Avila Adobe dominating visitor numbers, while Chinese American Museum consistently receives the lowest attendance across all time periods.
